definitions.title: Dot (Inner) Product
definitions.latex: \mathbf{u} \cdot \mathbf{v} = u_1 v_1 + u_2 v_2 + u_3 v_3 = |\mathbf{u}| |\mathbf{v}| \cos\theta
definitions.statement: The dot product of two vectors u and v is the scalar obtained by summing the products of their corresponding components, equal to the product of their magnitudes and the cosine of the angle theta between them (0 <= theta <= pi).
conditions: Vectors belong to Euclidean space R^n
definitions.explanation: Connects algebraic component operations directly to geometric angle measurement.
definitions.keyTakeaway: Two non-zero vectors are orthogonal if and only if their dot product vanishes: u . v = 0.

definitions.title: Vector Projection and Scalar Component
definitions.statement: The vector projection of u onto non-zero v represents the shadow cast by u along the line containing v, while the scalar component is its signed length.
definitions.explanation: Decomposes u into parallel and orthogonal components: u = proj_v u + (u - proj_v u).
definitions.keyTakeaway: Fundamental in computing physical work: W = F . D.
